note: Checksums are registered once and verified on every run. The CDC dataset metadata was not saved on 2026-09-28; see data/fresh/ for metadata retrieved later and results/audit/snapshot_vs_fresh.csv for the comparison.

cdc.dataset: PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data, 2025 release
cdc.processing: JSON response converted to CSV with pandas; no rows or columns dropped
cdc.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, Division of Population Health

census.processing: polygons with STATEFP == '37' converted to GeoJSON; coordinates rounded to 5 decimals
census.terms: U.S. Census Bureau public data product; the publisher states no restriction
census.use: map outlines only; generalized shapes, not used for any measurement or model

epa.processing: CSV inside the archive filtered to State == 'North Carolina'
epa.publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AirData / Air Quality System)
